verses.ar: تَبٰرَكَ الَّذِيۡ نَزَّلَ الۡفُرۡقَانَ عَلٰي عَبۡدِهٖ لِيَكُوۡنَ لِلۡعٰلَمِيۡنَ نَذِيۡرَاۙ‏
verses.en: Blessed is He who sent down the criterion to His servant, that it may be an admonition to all creatures

verses.ar: اِۨلَّذِيۡ لَهٗ مُلۡكُ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالۡاَرۡضِ وَلَمۡ يَتَّخِذۡ وَلَدًا وَّلَمۡ يَكُنۡ لَّهٗ شَرِيۡكٌ فِي الۡمُلۡكِ وَخَلَقَ كُلَّ شَيۡءٍ فَقَدَّرَهٗ تَقۡدِيۡرًا
verses.en: He to whom belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth: no son has He begotten, nor has He a partner in His dominion: it is He who created all things, and ordered them in due proportions

verses.ar: وَاتَّخَذُوۡا مِنۡ دُوۡنِهٖ٘ اٰلِهَةً لَّا يَخۡلُقُوۡنَ شَيۡـًٔا وَّهُمۡ يُخۡلَقُوۡنَ وَلَا يَمۡلِكُوۡنَ لِاَنۡفُسِهِمۡ ضَرًّا وَّلَا نَفۡعًا وَّلَا يَمۡلِكُوۡنَ مَوۡتًا وَّلَا حَيٰوةً وَّلَا نُشُوۡرًا
verses.en: Yet have they taken, besides him, gods that can create nothing but are themselves created; that have no control of hurt or good to themselves; nor can they control death nor life nor resurrection

verses.ar: وَقَالَ الَّذِيۡنَ كَفَرُوۡ٘ا اِنۡ هٰذَا٘ اِلَّا٘ اِفۡكُ اِۨفۡتَرٰىهُ وَاَعَانَهٗ عَلَيۡهِ قَوۡمٌ اٰخَرُوۡنَۚۛ فَقَدۡ جَآءُوۡ ظُلۡمًا وَّزُوۡرًاۚۛ‏
verses.en: But the misbelievers say: "Naught is this but a lie which he has forged, and others have helped him at it." In truth it is they who have put forward an iniquity and a falsehood

verses.ar: وَقَالُوۡ٘ا اَسَاطِيۡرُ الۡاَوَّلِيۡنَ اكۡتَتَبَهَا فَهِيَ تُمۡلٰي عَلَيۡهِ بُكۡرَةً وَّاَصِيۡلًا
verses.en: And they say: "Tales of the ancients, which he has caused to be written: and they are dictated before him morning and evening

verses.ar: قُلۡ اَنۡزَلَهُ الَّذِيۡ يَعۡلَمُ السِّرَّ فِي السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالۡاَرۡضِؕ اِنَّهٗ كَانَ غَفُوۡرًا رَّحِيۡمًا
verses.en: Say: "The (Qur'an) was sent down by Him who knows the mystery (that is) in the heavens and the earth: verily He is Oft-Forgiving, Most Merciful

verses.ar: وَقَالُوۡا مَالِ هٰذَا الرَّسُوۡلِ يَاۡكُلُ الطَّعَامَ وَيَمۡشِيۡ فِي الۡاَسۡوَاقِؕ لَوۡلَا٘ اُنۡزِلَ اِلَيۡهِ مَلَكٌ فَيَكُوۡنَ مَعَهٗ نَذِيۡرًاۙ‏
verses.en: And they say: "What sort of a messenger is this, who eats food, and walks through the streets? Why has not an angel been sent down to him to give admonition with him

verses.ar: اَوۡ يُلۡقٰ٘ي اِلَيۡهِ كَنۡزٌ اَوۡ تَكُوۡنُ لَهٗ جَنَّةٌ يَّاۡكُلُ مِنۡهَاؕ وَقَالَ الظّٰلِمُوۡنَ اِنۡ تَتَّبِعُوۡنَ اِلَّا رَجُلًا مَّسۡحُوۡرًا
verses.en: Or (Why) has not a treasure been bestowed on him, or why has he (not) a garden for enjoyment?" The wicked say: "Ye follow none other than a man bewitched

verses.ar: اُنۡظُرۡ كَيۡفَ ضَرَبُوۡا لَكَ الۡاَمۡثَالَ فَضَلُّوۡا فَلَا يَسۡتَطِيۡعُوۡنَ سَبِيۡلًاࣖ‏
verses.en: See what kinds of comparisons they make for thee! But they have gone astray, and never a way will they be able to find

verses.ar: تَبٰرَكَ الَّذِيۡ٘ اِنۡ شَآءَ جَعَلَ لَكَ خَيۡرًا مِّنۡ ذٰلِكَ جَنّٰتٍ تَجۡرِيۡ مِنۡ تَحۡتِهَا الۡاَنۡهٰرُۙ وَيَجۡعَلۡ لَّكَ قُصُوۡرًا
verses.en: Blessed is He who, if that were His will, could give thee better (things) than those,- Gardens beneath which rivers flow; and He could give thee palaces (secure to dwell in)

verses.ar: بَلۡ كَذَّبُوۡا بِالسَّاعَةِ وَاَعۡتَدۡنَا لِمَنۡ كَذَّبَ بِالسَّاعَةِ سَعِيۡرًاۚ‏
verses.en: Nay they deny the hour (of the judgment to come): but We have prepared a blazing fire for such as deny the hour

verses.ar: اِذَا رَاَتۡهُمۡ مِّنۡ مَّكَانٍۭ بَعِيۡدٍ سَمِعُوۡا لَهَا تَغَيُّظًا وَّزَفِيۡرًا
verses.en: When it sees them from a place far off, they will hear its fury and its ranging sigh

verses.ar: وَاِذَا٘ اُلۡقُوۡا مِنۡهَا مَكَانًا ضَيِّقًا مُّقَرَّنِيۡنَ دَعَوۡا هُنَالِكَ ثُبُوۡرًاؕ‏
verses.en: And when they are cast, bound together into a constricted place therein, they will plead for destruction there and then

verses.ar: لَا تَدۡعُوا الۡيَوۡمَ ثُبُوۡرًا وَّاحِدًا وَّادۡعُوۡا ثُبُوۡرًا كَثِيۡرًا
verses.en: This day plead not for a single destruction: plead for destruction oft-repeated

verses.ar: قُلۡ اَذٰلِكَ خَيۡرٌ اَمۡ جَنَّةُ الۡخُلۡدِ الَّتِيۡ وُعِدَ الۡمُتَّقُوۡنَؕ كَانَتۡ لَهُمۡ جَزَآءً وَّمَصِيۡرًا
verses.en: Say: "Is that best, or the eternal garden, promised to the righteous? for them, that is a reward as well as a goal (of attainment)

verses.ar: لَهُمۡ فِيۡهَا مَا يَشَآءُوۡنَ خٰلِدِيۡنَؕ كَانَ عَلٰي رَبِّكَ وَعۡدًا مَّسۡـُٔوۡلًا
verses.en: For them there will be therein all that they wish for: they will dwell (there) for aye: A promise to be prayed for from thy Lord

verses.ar: وَيَوۡمَ يَحۡشُرُهُمۡ وَمَا يَعۡبُدُوۡنَ مِنۡ دُوۡنِ اللّٰهِ فَيَقُوۡلُ ءَاَنۡتُمۡ اَضۡلَلۡتُمۡ عِبَادِيۡ هٰ٘ؤُلَآءِ اَمۡ هُمۡ ضَلُّوا السَّبِيۡلَؕ‏
verses.en: The day He will gather them together as well as those whom they worship besides Allah, He will ask: "Was it ye who let these My servants astray, or did they stray from the Path themselves

verses.ar: قَالُوۡا سُبۡحٰنَكَ مَا كَانَ يَنۭۡ بَغِيۡ لَنَا٘ اَنۡ نَّتَّخِذَ مِنۡ دُوۡنِكَ مِنۡ اَوۡلِيَآءَ وَلٰكِنۡ مَّتَّعۡتَهُمۡ وَاٰبَآءَهُمۡ حَتّٰي نَسُوا الذِّكۡرَۚ وَكَانُوۡا قَوۡمًاۭ بُوۡرًا
verses.en: They will say: "Glory to Thee! not meet was it for us that we should take for protectors others besides Thee: But Thou didst bestow, on them and their fathers, good things (in life), until they forgot the Message: for they were a people (worthless and) lost

verses.ar: فَقَدۡ كَذَّبُوۡكُمۡ بِمَا تَقُوۡلُوۡنَۙ فَمَا تَسۡتَطِيۡعُوۡنَ صَرۡفًا وَّلَا نَصۡرًاۚ وَمَنۡ يَّظۡلِمۡ مِّنۡكُمۡ نُذِقۡهُ عَذَابًا كَبِيۡرًا
verses.en: (Allah will say): "Now have they proved you liars in what ye say: so ye cannot avert (your penalty) nor (get) help." And whoever among you does wrong, him shall We cause to taste of a grievous Penalty

verses.ar: وَمَا٘ اَرۡسَلۡنَا قَبۡلَكَ مِنَ الۡمُرۡسَلِيۡنَ اِلَّا٘ اِنَّهُمۡ لَيَاۡكُلُوۡنَ الطَّعَامَ وَيَمۡشُوۡنَ فِي الۡاَسۡوَاقِؕ وَجَعَلۡنَا بَعۡضَكُمۡ لِبَعۡضٍ فِتۡنَةًؕ اَتَصۡبِرُوۡنَۚ وَكَانَ رَبُّكَ بَصِيۡرًاࣖ‏
verses.en: And the messengers whom We sent before thee were all (men) who ate food and walked through the streets: We have made some of you as a trial for others: will ye have patience? for Allah is One Who sees (all things)

verses.ar: وَقَالَ الَّذِيۡنَ لَا يَرۡجُوۡنَ لِقَآءَنَا لَوۡلَا٘ اُنۡزِلَ عَلَيۡنَا الۡمَلٰٓئِكَةُ اَوۡ نَرٰي رَبَّنَاؕ لَقَدِ اسۡتَكۡبَرُوۡا فِيۡ٘ اَنۡفُسِهِمۡ وَعَتَوۡ عُتُوًّا كَبِيۡرًا
verses.en: Such as fear not the meeting with Us (for Judgment) say: "Why are not the angels sent down to us, or (why) do we not see our Lord?" Indeed they have an arrogant conceit of themselves, and mighty is the insolence of their impiety

verses.ar: يَوۡمَ يَرَوۡنَ الۡمَلٰٓئِكَةَ لَا بُشۡرٰي يَوۡمَئِذٍ لِّلۡمُجۡرِمِيۡنَ وَيَقُوۡلُوۡنَ حِجۡرًا مَّحۡجُوۡرًا
verses.en: The Day they see the angels,- no joy will there be to the sinners that Day: The (angels) will say: "There is a barrier forbidden (to you) altogether

verses.ar: وَقَدِمۡنَا٘ اِلٰي مَا عَمِلُوۡا مِنۡ عَمَلٍ فَجَعَلۡنٰهُ هَبَآءً مَّنۡثُوۡرًا
verses.en: And We shall turn to whatever deeds they did (in this life), and We shall make such deeds as floating dust scattered about

verses.ar: اَصۡحٰبُ الۡجَنَّةِ يَوۡمَئِذٍ خَيۡرٌ مُّسۡتَقَرًّا وَّاَحۡسَنُ مَقِيۡلًا
verses.en: The Companions of the Garden will be well, that Day, in their abode, and have the fairest of places for repose

verses.ar: وَيَوۡمَ تَشَقَّقُ السَّمَآءُ بِالۡغَمَامِ وَنُزِّلَ الۡمَلٰٓئِكَةُ تَنۡزِيۡلًا
verses.en: The Day the heaven shall be rent asunder with clouds, and angels shall be sent down, descending (in ranks)

verses.ar: اَلۡمُلۡكُ يَوۡمَئِذِ اِۨلۡحَقُّ لِلرَّحۡمٰنِؕ وَكَانَ يَوۡمًا عَلَي الۡكٰفِرِيۡنَ عَسِيۡرًا
verses.en: That Day, the dominion as of right and truth, shall be (wholly) for (Allah) Most Merciful: it will be a Day of dire difficulty for the misbelievers

verses.ar: وَيَوۡمَ يَعَضُّ الظَّالِمُ عَلٰي يَدَيۡهِ يَقُوۡلُ يٰلَيۡتَنِي اتَّخَذۡتُ مَعَ الرَّسُوۡلِ سَبِيۡلًا
verses.en: The Day that the wrong-doer will bite at his hands, he will say, "Oh! would that I had taken a (straight) path with the Messenger

verses.ar: يٰوَيۡلَتٰي لَيۡتَنِيۡ لَمۡ اَتَّخِذۡ فُلَانًا خَلِيۡلًا
verses.en: Ah! woe is me! Would that I had never taken such a one for a friend

verses.ar: لَقَدۡ اَضَلَّنِيۡ عَنِ الذِّكۡرِ بَعۡدَ اِذۡ جَآءَنِيۡؕ وَكَانَ الشَّيۡطٰنُ لِلۡاِنۡسَانِ خَذُوۡلًا
verses.en: He did lead me astray from the Message (of Allah) after it had come to me! Ah! the Evil One is but a traitor to man

verses.ar: وَقَالَ الرَّسُوۡلُ يٰرَبِّ اِنَّ قَوۡمِي اتَّخَذُوۡا هٰذَا الۡقُرۡاٰنَ مَهۡجُوۡرًا
verses.en: Then the Messenger will say: "O my Lord! Truly my people took this Qur'an for just foolish nonsense

verses.ar: وَكَذٰلِكَ جَعَلۡنَا لِكُلِّ نَبِيٍّ عَدُوًّا مِّنَ الۡمُجۡرِمِيۡنَؕ وَكَفٰي بِرَبِّكَ هَادِيًا وَّنَصِيۡرًا
verses.en: Thus have We made for every prophet an enemy among the sinners: but enough is thy Lord to guide and to help

verses.ar: وَقَالَ الَّذِيۡنَ كَفَرُوۡا لَوۡلَا نُزِّلَ عَلَيۡهِ الۡقُرۡاٰنُ جُمۡلَةً وَّاحِدَةًۚۛ كَذٰلِكَۚۛ لِنُثَبِّتَ بِهٖ فُؤَادَكَ وَرَتَّلۡنٰهُ تَرۡتِيۡلًا
verses.en: Those who reject Faith say: "Why is not the Qur'an revealed to him all at once? Thus (is it revealed), that We may strengthen thy heart thereby, and We have rehearsed it to thee in slow, well-arranged stages, gradually

verses.ar: وَلَا يَاۡتُوۡنَكَ بِمَثَلٍ اِلَّا جِئۡنٰكَ بِالۡحَقِّ وَاَحۡسَنَ تَفۡسِيۡرًاؕ‏
verses.en: And no question do they bring to thee but We reveal to thee the truth and the best explanation (thereof)

verses.ar: اَلَّذِيۡنَ يُحۡشَرُوۡنَ عَلٰي وُجُوۡهِهِمۡ اِلٰي جَهَنَّمَۙ اُولٰٓئِكَ شَرٌّ مَّكَانًا وَّاَضَلُّ سَبِيۡلًاࣖ‏
verses.en: Those who will be gathered to Hell (prone) on their faces,- they will be in an evil plight, and, as to Path, most astray

verses.ar: وَلَقَدۡ اٰتَيۡنَا مُوۡسَي الۡكِتٰبَ وَجَعَلۡنَا مَعَهٗ٘ اَخَاهُ هٰرُوۡنَ وَزِيۡرًاۚۖ‏
verses.en: (Before this,) We sent Moses The Book, and appointed his brother Aaron with him as minister

verses.ar: فَقُلۡنَا اذۡهَبَا٘ اِلَي الۡقَوۡمِ الَّذِيۡنَ كَذَّبُوۡا بِاٰيٰتِنَاؕ فَدَمَّرۡنٰهُمۡ تَدۡمِيۡرًاؕ‏
verses.en: And We command: "Go ye both, to the people who have rejected our Signs:" And those (people) We destroyed with utter destruction

verses.ar: وَقَوۡمَ نُوۡحٍ لَّمَّا كَذَّبُوا الرُّسُلَ اَغۡرَقۡنٰهُمۡ وَجَعَلۡنٰهُمۡ لِلنَّاسِ اٰيَةًؕ وَاَعۡتَدۡنَا لِلظّٰلِمِيۡنَ عَذَابًا اَلِيۡمًاۚۙ‏
verses.en: And the people of Noah,- when they rejected the messengers, We drowned them, and We made them as a Sign for mankind; and We have prepared for (all) wrong-doers a grievous Penalty

verses.ar: وَّعَادًا وَّثَمُوۡدَا۠ وَاَصۡحٰبَ الرَّسِّ وَقُرُوۡنًاۭ بَيۡنَ ذٰلِكَ كَثِيۡرًا
verses.en: As also 'Ad and Thamud, and the Companions of the Rass, and many a generation between them

verses.ar: وَكُلًّا ضَرَبۡنَا لَهُ الۡاَمۡثَالَؗ وَكُلًّا تَبَّرۡنَا تَتۡبِيۡرًا
verses.en: To each one We set forth Parables and examples; and each one We broke to utter annihilation (for their sins)

verses.ar: وَلَقَدۡ اَتَوۡا عَلَي الۡقَرۡيَةِ الَّتِيۡ٘ اُمۡطِرَتۡ مَطَرَ السَّوۡءِؕ اَفَلَمۡ يَكُوۡنُوۡا يَرَوۡنَهَاۚ بَلۡ كَانُوۡا لَا يَرۡجُوۡنَ نُشُوۡرًا
verses.en: And the (Unbelievers) must indeed have passed by the town on which was rained a shower of evil: did they not then see it (with their own eyes)? But they fear not the Resurrection

verses.ar: وَاِذَا رَاَوۡكَ اِنۡ يَّتَّخِذُوۡنَكَ اِلَّا هُزُوًاؕ اَهٰذَا الَّذِيۡ بَعَثَ اللّٰهُ رَسُوۡلًا
verses.en: When they see thee, they treat thee no otherwise than in mockery: "Is this the one whom Allah has sent as a messenger

verses.ar: اِنۡ كَادَ لَيُضِلُّنَا عَنۡ اٰلِهَتِنَا لَوۡلَا٘ اَنۡ صَبَرۡنَا عَلَيۡهَاؕ وَسَوۡفَ يَعۡلَمُوۡنَ حِيۡنَ يَرَوۡنَ الۡعَذَابَ مَنۡ اَضَلُّ سَبِيۡلًا
verses.en: He indeed would well-nigh have misled us from our gods, had it not been that we were constant to them!" - Soon will they know, when they see the Penalty, who it is that is most misled in Path

verses.ar: اَرَءَيۡتَ مَنِ اتَّخَذَ اِلٰهَهٗ هَوٰىهُؕ اَفَاَنۡتَ تَكُوۡنُ عَلَيۡهِ وَكِيۡلًاۙ‏
verses.en: Seest thou such a one as taketh for his god his own passion (or impulse)? Couldst thou be a disposer of affairs for him

verses.ar: اَمۡ تَحۡسَبُ اَنَّ اَكۡثَرَهُمۡ يَسۡمَعُوۡنَ اَوۡ يَعۡقِلُوۡنَؕ اِنۡ هُمۡ اِلَّا كَالۡاَنۡعَامِ بَلۡ هُمۡ اَضَلُّ سَبِيۡلًاࣖ‏
verses.en: Or thinkest thou that most of them listen or understand? They are only like cattle;- nay, they are worse astray in Path

verses.ar: اَلَمۡ تَرَ اِلٰي رَبِّكَ كَيۡفَ مَدَّ الظِّلَّۚ وَلَوۡ شَآءَ لَجَعَلَهٗ سَاكِنًاۚ ثُمَّ جَعَلۡنَا الشَّمۡسَ عَلَيۡهِ دَلِيۡلًاۙ‏
verses.en: Hast thou not turned thy vision to thy Lord?- How He doth prolong the shadow! If He willed, He could make it stationary! then do We make the sun its guide

verses.ar: ثُمَّ قَبَضۡنٰهُ اِلَيۡنَا قَبۡضًا يَّسِيۡرًا
verses.en: Then We draw it in towards Ourselves,- a contraction by easy stages

verses.ar: وَهُوَ الَّذِيۡ جَعَلَ لَكُمُ الَّيۡلَ لِبَاسًا وَّالنَّوۡمَ سُبَاتًا وَّجَعَلَ النَّهَارَ نُشُوۡرًا
verses.en: And He it is Who makes the Night as a Robe for you, and Sleep as Repose, and makes the Day (as it were) a Resurrection

verses.ar: وَهُوَ الَّذِيۡ٘ اَرۡسَلَ الرِّيٰحَ بُشۡرًاۭ بَيۡنَ يَدَيۡ رَحۡمَتِهٖۚ وَاَنۡزَلۡنَا مِنَ السَّمَآءِ مَآءً طَهُوۡرًاۙ‏
verses.en: And He it is Who sends the winds as heralds of glad tidings, going before His mercy, and We send down pure water from the sky

verses.ar: لِّنُحۡيِۦَ بِهٖ بَلۡدَةً مَّيۡتًا وَّنُسۡقِيَهٗ مِمَّا خَلَقۡنَا٘ اَنۡعَامًا وَّاَنَاسِيَّ كَثِيۡرًا
verses.en: That with it We may give life to a dead land, and slake the thirst of things We have created,- cattle and men in great numbers

verses.ar: وَلَقَدۡ صَرَّفۡنٰهُ بَيۡنَهُمۡ لِيَذَّكَّرُوۡاؗۖ فَاَبٰ٘ي اَكۡثَرُ النَّاسِ اِلَّا كُفُوۡرًا
verses.en: And We have distributed the (water) amongst them, in order that they may celebrate (our) praises, but most men are averse (to aught) but (rank) ingratitude

verses.ar: وَلَوۡ شِئۡنَا لَبَعَثۡنَا فِيۡ كُلِّ قَرۡيَةٍ نَّذِيۡرًاؗۖ‏
verses.en: Had it been Our Will, We could have sent a warner to every centre of population

verses.ar: فَلَا تُطِعِ الۡكٰفِرِيۡنَ وَجَاهِدۡهُمۡ بِهٖ جِهَادًا كَبِيۡرًا
verses.en: Therefore listen not to the Unbelievers, but strive against them with the utmost strenuousness, with the (Qur'an)

verses.ar: وَهُوَ الَّذِيۡ مَرَجَ الۡبَحۡرَيۡنِ هٰذَا عَذۡبٌ فُرَاتٌ وَّهٰذَا مِلۡحٌ اُجَاجٌۚ وَجَعَلَ بَيۡنَهُمَا بَرۡزَخًا وَّحِجۡرًا مَّحۡجُوۡرًا
verses.en: It is He Who has let free the two bodies of flowing water: One palatable and sweet, and the other salt and bitter; yet has He made a barrier between them, a partition that is forbidden to be passed

verses.ar: وَهُوَ الَّذِيۡ خَلَقَ مِنَ الۡمَآءِ بَشَرًا فَجَعَلَهٗ نَسَبًا وَّصِهۡرًاؕ وَكَانَ رَبُّكَ قَدِيۡرًا
verses.en: It is He Who has created man from water: then has He established relationships of lineage and marriage: for thy Lord has power (over all things)

verses.ar: وَيَعۡبُدُوۡنَ مِنۡ دُوۡنِ اللّٰهِ مَا لَا يَنۡفَعُهُمۡ وَلَا يَضُرُّهُمۡؕ وَكَانَ الۡكَافِرُ عَلٰي رَبِّهٖ ظَهِيۡرًا
verses.en: Yet do they worship, besides Allah, things that can neither profit them nor harm them: and the Misbeliever is a helper (of Evil), against his own Lord

verses.ar: وَمَا٘ اَرۡسَلۡنٰكَ اِلَّا مُبَشِّرًا وَّنَذِيۡرًا
verses.en: But thee We only sent to give glad tidings and admonition

verses.ar: قُلۡ مَا٘ اَسۡـَٔلُكُمۡ عَلَيۡهِ مِنۡ اَجۡرٍ اِلَّا مَنۡ شَآءَ اَنۡ يَّتَّخِذَ اِلٰي رَبِّهٖ سَبِيۡلًا
verses.en: Say: "No reward do I ask of you for it but this: that each one who will may take a (straight) Path to his Lord

verses.ar: وَتَوَكَّلۡ عَلَي الۡحَيِّ الَّذِيۡ لَا يَمُوۡتُ وَسَبِّحۡ بِحَمۡدِهٖؕ وَكَفٰي بِهٖ بِذُنُوۡبِ عِبَادِهٖ خَبِيۡرَاۚۛۙ‏
verses.en: And put thy trust in Him Who lives and dies not; and celebrate his praise; and enough is He to be acquainted with the faults of His servants

verses.ar: اِۨلَّذِيۡ خَلَقَ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالۡاَرۡضَ وَمَا بَيۡنَهُمَا فِيۡ سِتَّةِ اَيَّامٍ ثُمَّ اسۡتَوٰي عَلَي الۡعَرۡشِۚۛ اَلرَّحۡمٰنُ فَسۡـَٔلۡ بِهٖ خَبِيۡرًا
verses.en: He Who created the heavens and the earth and all that is between, in six days, and is firmly established on the Throne (of Authority): Allah Most Gracious: ask thou, then, about Him of any acquainted (with such things)

verses.ar: وَاِذَا قِيۡلَ لَهُمُ اسۡجُدُوۡا لِلرَّحۡمٰنِۚ قَالُوۡا وَمَا الرَّحۡمٰنُࣗ اَنَسۡجُدُ لِمَا تَاۡمُرُنَا وَزَادَهُمۡ نُفُوۡرًاࣛࣖ‏
verses.en: When it is said to them, "Prostrate to (Allah) Most Gracious!", they say, "And what is (Allah) Most Gracious? Shall we prostrate to that which thou commandest us?" And it increases their flight (from the Truth)

verses.ar: تَبٰرَكَ الَّذِيۡ جَعَلَ فِي السَّمَآءِ بُرُوۡجًا وَّجَعَلَ فِيۡهَا سِرٰجًا وَّقَمَرًا مُّنِيۡرًا
verses.en: Blessed is He Who made constellations in the skies, and placed therein a Lamp and a Moon giving light

verses.ar: وَهُوَ الَّذِيۡ جَعَلَ الَّيۡلَ وَالنَّهَارَ خِلۡفَةً لِّمَنۡ اَرَادَ اَنۡ يَّذَّكَّرَ اَوۡ اَرَادَ شُكُوۡرًا
verses.en: And it is He Who made the Night and the Day to follow each other: for such as have the will to celebrate His praises or to show their gratitude

verses.ar: وَعِبَادُ الرَّحۡمٰنِ الَّذِيۡنَ يَمۡشُوۡنَ عَلَي الۡاَرۡضِ هَوۡنًا وَّاِذَا خَاطَبَهُمُ الۡجٰهِلُوۡنَ قَالُوۡا سَلٰمًا
verses.en: And the servants of (Allah) Most Gracious are those who walk on the earth in humility, and when the ignorant address them, they say, "Peace

verses.ar: وَالَّذِيۡنَ يَبِيۡتُوۡنَ لِرَبِّهِمۡ سُجَّدًا وَّقِيَامًا
verses.en: Those who spend the night in adoration of their Lord prostrate and standing

verses.ar: وَالَّذِيۡنَ يَقُوۡلُوۡنَ رَبَّنَا اصۡرِفۡ عَنَّا عَذَابَ جَهَنَّمَࣗۖ اِنَّ عَذَابَهَا كَانَ غَرَامًاࣗۖ‏
verses.en: Those who say, "Our Lord! avert from us the Wrath of Hell, for its Wrath is indeed an affliction grievous

verses.ar: اِنَّهَا سَآءَتۡ مُسۡتَقَرًّا وَّمُقَامًا
verses.en: Evil indeed is it as an abode, and as a place to rest in

verses.ar: وَالَّذِيۡنَ اِذَا٘ اَنۡفَقُوۡا لَمۡ يُسۡرِفُوۡا وَلَمۡ يَقۡتُرُوۡا وَكَانَ بَيۡنَ ذٰلِكَ قَوَامًا
verses.en: Those who, when they spend, are not extravagant and not niggardly, but hold a just (balance) between those (extremes)

verses.ar: وَالَّذِيۡنَ لَا يَدۡعُوۡنَ مَعَ اللّٰهِ اِلٰهًا اٰخَرَ وَلَا يَقۡتُلُوۡنَ النَّفۡسَ الَّتِيۡ حَرَّمَ اللّٰهُ اِلَّا بِالۡحَقِّ وَلَا يَزۡنُوۡنَؕۚ وَمَنۡ يَّفۡعَلۡ ذٰلِكَ يَلۡقَ اَثَامًاۙ‏
verses.en: Those who invoke not, with Allah, any other god, nor slay such life as Allah has made sacred except for just cause, nor commit fornication; - and any that does this (not only) meets punishment

verses.ar: يُّضٰعَفۡ لَهُ الۡعَذَابُ يَوۡمَ الۡقِيٰمَةِ وَيَخۡلُدۡ فِيۡهٖ مُهَانًاࣗۖ‏
verses.en: (But) the Penalty on the Day of Judgment will be doubled to him, and he will dwell therein in ignominy

verses.ar: اِلَّا مَنۡ تَابَ وَاٰمَنَ وَعَمِلَ عَمَلًا صَالِحًا فَاُولٰٓئِكَ يُبَدِّلُ اللّٰهُ سَيِّاٰتِهِمۡ حَسَنٰتٍؕ وَكَانَ اللّٰهُ غَفُوۡرًا رَّحِيۡمًا
verses.en: Unless he repents, believes, and works righteous deeds, for Allah will change the evil of such persons into good, and Allah is Oft-Forgiving, Most Merciful

verses.ar: وَمَنۡ تَابَ وَعَمِلَ صَالِحًا فَاِنَّهٗ يَتُوۡبُ اِلَي اللّٰهِ مَتَابًا
verses.en: And whoever repents and does good has truly turned to Allah with an (acceptable) conversion

verses.ar: وَالَّذِيۡنَ لَا يَشۡهَدُوۡنَ الزُّوۡرَۙ وَاِذَا مَرُّوۡا بِاللَّغۡوِ مَرُّوۡا كِرَامًا
verses.en: Those who witness no falsehood, and, if they pass by futility, they pass by it with honourable (avoidance)

verses.ar: وَالَّذِيۡنَ اِذَا ذُكِّرُوۡا بِاٰيٰتِ رَبِّهِمۡ لَمۡ يَخِرُّوۡا عَلَيۡهَا صُمًّا وَّعُمۡيَانًا
verses.en: Those who, when they are admonished with the Signs of their Lord, droop not down at them as if they were deaf or blind

verses.ar: وَالَّذِيۡنَ يَقُوۡلُوۡنَ رَبَّنَا هَبۡ لَنَا مِنۡ اَزۡوَاجِنَا وَذُرِّيّٰتِنَا قُرَّةَ اَعۡيُنٍ وَّاجۡعَلۡنَا لِلۡمُتَّقِيۡنَ اِمَامًا
verses.en: And those who pray, "Our Lord! Grant unto us wives and offspring who will be the comfort of our eyes, and give us (the grace) to lead the righteous

verses.ar: اُولٰٓئِكَ يُجۡزَوۡنَ الۡغُرۡفَةَ بِمَا صَبَرُوۡا وَيُلَقَّوۡنَ فِيۡهَا تَحِيَّةً وَّسَلٰمًاۙ‏
verses.en: Those are the ones who will be rewarded with the highest place in heaven, because of their patient constancy: therein shall they be met with salutations and peace

verses.ar: خٰلِدِيۡنَ فِيۡهَاؕ حَسُنَتۡ مُسۡتَقَرًّا وَّمُقَامًا
verses.en: Dwelling therein;- how beautiful an abode and place of rest

verses.ar: قُلۡ مَا يَعۡبَؤُا بِكُمۡ رَبِّيۡ لَوۡلَا دُعَآؤُكُمۡۚ فَقَدۡ كَذَّبۡتُمۡ فَسَوۡفَ يَكُوۡنُ لِزَامًاࣖ‏
verses.en: Say (to the Rejecters): "My Lord is not uneasy because of you if ye call not on Him: But ye have indeed rejected (Him), and soon will come the inevitable (punishment)
